sourceNotes.rawContent:
- Elevate your occasion look with this stunning mint green and white CZ choker necklace set. Featuring a beautifully hand-crafted design, the choker is adorned with alternating mint stones and sparkling cubic zirconia, creating a fresh, luxurious glow. The matching earrings complete the ensemble, making it perfect for weddings, parties, festive events, and bridal wear.
- Crafted with premium silver plating and high-shine stones, this jewelry set sits comfortably on the neckline and adds instant elegance to any outfit. Ideal for gifting or enhancing your traditional or contemporary look.
